title: perf(canary): auto-detect latency/throughput regressions + rollout guards
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We continue to see intermittent latency regressions after model/infra rollouts that evade our existing smoke checks. This PR introduces an automated canary detector + rollout guard to catch statistically significant latency and throughput regressions during traffic-shift rollouts and pause/rollback unsafe changes.

What this PR does: Adds a canary detection service (baseline + rolling windows), percentile-based regressions tests (P50/P95/P99), throughput checks, KV-cache-aware baselines, hysteresis to avoid flapping, and an operator-configurable rollout guard that integrates with the routing plane to automatically pause or rollback canary traffic when thresholds are exceeded. Also wires alerts into Console and creates Linear tickets for triggered regressions.

Implementation highlights: detector computes dynamic thresholds from a configurable historical baseline window (default 1h) and compares live canary windows (default 1m, 5m) using bootstrap percentile comparison + Mann–Whitney U as fallback for small samples. Thresholds support absolute and relative modes and are scaled by request mix (embedding vs text) and KV hit-rate. Hysteresis uses separate exceed and recover multipliers and a configurable min-duration before action. The rollout guard hooks into the router: when the detector flags regression above severity X it will first pause traffic shift, then optionally rollback (configurable).

Files touched: core detector, rollout guard, perf harness, unit+integration tests, Console UI for canary config, Helm values and docs.

Testing: added perf-harness canary_sim to reproduce regressions, unit tests over detector math (multiple seed windows), e2e sim that does automated traffic shifts and verifies guard behavior. Local perf runs used a mix of synthetic model latencies and real model response distributions. CI includes a lightweight perf smoke suite; heavier perf-regression checks run in scheduled pipelines.

Backward compatibility and rollout: feature-flagged behind feature.perf.canary.autodetect. Default config is conservative (higher sensitivity to latency spikes, hysteresis enabled). No breaking API changes.

Rollout plan: staged rollout to Dedicated clusters first (low risk) -> host pool canaries -> global rollouts. Monitor Console alerts and Linear tickets created by the webhook.

Follow-ups: dashboard for canary history aggregation, automated tuning of thresholds using historical false-positive rates.

review_comments:
Ethan Walker: request changes - detector should account for request-mix weighting (embedding vs text); suggested adding a KV-hit multiplier before applying relative thresholds.
Maya Chen (author): replied - added KV-aware scaling and added unit tests to cover high/low KV hit scenarios. Included docs about tuning for mixed workloads.
Priya Desai: requested extra tests for small-sample behavior and edge cases where request rate is very low; also asked for clearer guidance in the runbook.
Maya Chen: added Mann-Whitney U fallback and extra e2e sim scenarios that reproduce low-sample edge cases; updated runbook.
Omar Rahman: approval - verified guard behavior in Dedicated staging and safety of default configs.
CI: perf-regression initially failed on a flaky test (canary_sim timing); re-ran scheduled pipeline after adding a 200ms jitter tolerance; all checks passed on re-run.
ci_details: build: pass; unit-tests: pass; lint: pass; perf-smoke: pass; perf-regression: pass (after re-run); e2e-canary: pass; codecov: 82% (+1.2%)
release_notes:
- Add automated performance canary detector for latency and throughput regressions.
- Add rollout guard that can pause or rollback canary traffic when regressions are detected.
- Add canary simulation harness and integration tests.
- Add Console UI to configure canary thresholds and view live canary status.
tests: Unit tests for detector math and hysteresis; integration tests for guard + router; perf-harness scenarios (steady-state, KV-churn, model latency spike); e2e sim validates pause and rollback actions under noisy conditions.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout: enable in Dedicated staging -> 5% host pool canaries -> 25% -> 50% -> full. Manual monitor at each step; auto-pause on guard trigger; webhook creates Linear ticket for triage.
notes_for_oncall: If guard triggers in production: check detector windows (baseline vs canary), KV hit rates, and recent model changes. Use Console to inspect live trace and optionally rollback via routing dashboard. Linear ticket created with detector summary for faster triage.
